info.name: MODO Mobile Admin API - CRUD and Reviews
info.description: Customer PO and sales order CRUD, lookups, conversion and negative tests use admin_token without module permissions. Run Admin app authentication, Admin commercial lookups, Admin customer PO CRUD, Admin sales order CRUD, then Admin PO conversion and negative cases. Set customer_id, site_id and mix_design_id from lookups. Import with the sales mobile environment. Use the main-app admin login and admin_token for lead qualification/approval and quotation review. Sales login/token are separate. Set lead_id and quotation_id from sales responses, or use the shared environment to capture them automatically. Run individual requests in workflow order.

item.name: Admin app authentication
item.description: Main admin app token; separate from sales api_token. PO/order CRUD and conversion need no module permissions. Lead/quotation review separately requires CRM_LEAD VIEW/UPDATE/APPROVE and QUOTATION VIEW/APPROVE permissions. Set plant_id to an accessible plant. Share the same Postman environment between collections so lead_id and quotation_id captured by sales requests are available here. Run requests individually; approval/rejection are alternatives.
